title: Choosing a birthday present
instructions: İki kardeş annelerine hediye seçiyor. Fikirleri ve son kararı takip et.

script.speaker: a
script.text: Mum's birthday is next week. What shall we get her?

script.speaker: a
script.text: She got one for Christmas. What about flowers?

script.speaker: b
script.text: Flowers are nice, but they don't last long. She's always saying she wants to learn to paint.

script.speaker: a
script.text: Oh, good idea! We could buy her a painting course.

script.speaker: b
script.text: Yes. There's one at the community centre on Saturday mornings.

script.speaker: b
script.text: Eighty pounds for eight weeks. So forty each.

questions.prompt: Why don't they buy a handbag?
What is the problem with flowers?
What does their mum want to learn?
questions.evidence: She's always saying she wants to learn to paint.

questions.prompt: How much will each person pay?
questions.feedback: Kurs seksen pound; kişi başı kırk.
